notes.title: Nature is shaping-up
notes.content:
Hi there, ExcellentFrame here!

I've been hard at work making lots of progress on Mountain Retreat and taking the time to improve the graphics and add content to the game!

As of today, the game is feature-complete and I'm currently adding more content and polish to make the game as rich as can be.

Meanwhile, I've added a few new screenshots of development so far as I'm focussing on polishing the look and feel of the game.

Thanks for checking out Mountain Retreat, with more updates to follow soon!
